required: First launch contains no compulsory survey, registration or offer.
evidence: Fresh install on every target; screenshot and navigation trace.

required: Share/deep-link import bypasses education and preserves selected files/draft.
evidence: OS share tests plus local manifest check.

required: Picker cancellation preserves typed instruction.
evidence: UI regression test on phone and web.

required: Real synthetic sample uses actual local engines and is labelled demo.
evidence: Independent output reopen, searchable text check and zero-network local recipe trace.

required: First remote prompt waits for explicit consent, with provider named.
evidence: Network assertion before and after consent.

required: Decline/withdraw consent leaves local actions usable.
evidence: Permission-state tests and retained-draft check.

required: No file names, content, raw prompts or page images enter analytics.
evidence: Allowlist schema tests and network payload inspection.

required: OS backup policy matches local-data disclosures.
evidence: Android and Apple backup configuration review with entitlement/document distinction.

required: Three free successful intents work; next request sees pre-job offer.
evidence: Atomic reservation/commit tests across concurrent clients.

required: Multi-operation batch consumes one completed intent.
evidence: Ledger shows one commit for merge/OCR/compress chain.

required: Clarification, technical retry and app-caused repair do not add debits.
evidence: Idempotent job ledger tests.

required: Cancelled/failed coupled job releases allowance.
evidence: Crash, timeout and explicit cancel simulations.

required: Partial independent batch is charged once only on accepted successful output; remaining retry is same intent.
evidence: Acceptance/retry/lease integration tests.

required: Client falsely reporting failure cannot exhaust provider budget.
evidence: Gateway rate caps, bounded retry and lease-abuse test.

required: Allowance windows and renewal dates are separate; restore/upgrade does not create extra quota.
evidence: End-of-month, leap-day, time-zone and concurrent-device cases.

required: First free result remains exportable with paywall dismissed.
evidence: UI+file-save assertions after dismissal and logout.

required: Both monthly and annual prices show actual charge period prominently.
evidence: Localized store metadata screenshot tests.

required: No stale/invented price when product metadata cannot load.
evidence: Store network/error/price-change simulations.

required: Free exit, restore, legal text and selected-plan state are accessible.
evidence: Screen reader, keyboard, contrast and large-text audit.

required: Offer closes once; no chained downsell, countdown or false award.
evidence: Navigation/elements assertions and copy review.

required: Unsupported/broken engine never presented as fixed by subscribing.
evidence: Capability off/engine failure with free/pro users.

required: Pro exhaustion shows reset/local options, not duplicate Pro purchase.
evidence: Entitled user at zero allowance UI test.

required: Checkout double taps cannot create duplicate charge attempts.
evidence: Sandbox and gateway idempotency tests.

required: Pending payment preserves work and disables second purchase prompt.
evidence: Store pending/approval scenario tests.

required: Success redirect without authoritative verification cannot grant entitlement.
evidence: Forged/expired redirect and receipt tests.

required: Duplicate and out-of-order webhooks reconcile safely.
evidence: Signed-event replay, stale renewal and refund ordering tests.

required: Verified purchase resumes the same job only with current local manifest.
evidence: File order/content changes during external checkout.

required: Restore supports success/no match/conflicting account without unapproved ownership transfer.
evidence: Two app accounts and two store accounts in sandbox.

required: Cancelled renewal keeps access until verified expiration.
evidence: Native subscription lifecycle test.

required: Grace, hold, pause, expiry and revocation follow provider state.
evidence: Sandbox/server lifecycle fixtures on chosen providers.

required: Refund state is mapped to provider entitlement semantics rather than blanket immediate expiry.
evidence: Partial/full refund and revocation fixtures.

required: Optional linking restores Pro on another platform without syncing files.
evidence: Cross-platform identity test and network capture.

required: Existing cross-platform Pro avoids accidental second subscription.
evidence: Native/web account + current entitlement tests.

required: Web purchase has recoverable identity, without blocking first free use.
evidence: New browser/recovery link/account takeover-resistance test.

required: Manage/cancel routes to actual provider; survey cannot block cancellation.
evidence: Store and direct-provider management route tests.

required: Account deletion is available and distinguishes subscription/local-data deletion.
evidence: Deletion journey and service record retention test.

required: Valid cached access is not removed by a temporary server outage.
evidence: Bounded cache expiry, reconnect and revocation tests.

required: Local execution continues after a valid plan when resources are available.
evidence: Disable network during merge/OCR; inspect output.

required: Cancel Save/Share never marks file as saved/delivered.
evidence: Provider/platform event-specific tests.

required: Missing history handle produces reimport request, not false download.
evidence: Browser eviction/relaunch tests.

required: Recipe replay uses no unnecessary AI call and requests new local files.
evidence: Network and entitlement tests.

required: Product-share action excludes current PDF and its name.
evidence: Share payload inspection.

required: Review prompt is platform-native, un-incentivized and not sentiment-gated.
evidence: Eligibility schedule and review API audit.

required: Notification requests require a genuine benefit and optional permission.
evidence: Denied permission, suspended job and consent tests.

required: Diagnostics preview excludes private content and attachments by default.
evidence: Payload and UI verification with synthetic sensitive strings.

required: No production experiments, offers or ad writes enabled by the pack alone.
evidence: Default config and permission audit.

required: Stable assignment cannot change price halfway through checkout.
evidence: Concurrent config/checkout tests.

required: Trial disabled by default; eligible/ineligible terms and dates are provider-backed if enabled.
evidence: Provider sandbox eligibility and renewal-date tests before rollout.

required: Reports separate earned revenue, advance cash, channel fees and paid/blended CAC.
evidence: Reconciliation against provider test transactions and acquisition ledger.

required: Added sheets preserve original white/pastel UI with no permanent tool grid.
evidence: Compare all relevant states to approved images and record deviations.

required: Phone keyboard, split tablet, web dialogs and Mac focus work with large text/reduced motion.
evidence: Platform visual and accessibility evidence.

required: No borrowed competitor testimonials, branding or unverified savings metrics ship.
evidence: Asset licence and claim audit.
